facts.text: Tea's brewed, lads, and the gold's on the bus. Somebody pass the biscuits and mind the cliff.
facts.why: Charlie never says this. His famous line is 'You're only supposed to blow the bloody doors off!', and the film's last words are 'Hang on a minute, lads; I've got a great idea.'
facts.fix: You're only supposed to blow the bloody doors off!

fix_note.text: You're only supposed to blow the bloody doors off!

vibe.verdict: Bridger's prison canteen is a clever frame and the three Minis look great, but the dishes are mostly Turin food rather than the film's own jokes.
